name: Original shore-to-Vilverin running and swimming Athletics use

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local goal=nil;local arrived=false
local path=nil
local index=1
local timer=0
local age=0;local runTime=0;local swimTime=0
local last=self.position
local stuck=0
local attempts=0
local function route()
 if not goal then
  local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x66ac8));if not target or not target:isValid() then return end
  local best=nil
  local eyeHeight=camera.getPosition().z-self.position.z
  print('AthleticsRoute camera='..tostring(camera.getPosition())..' player='..tostring(self.position)..' eyeHeight='..eyeHeight..' mode='..tostring(camera.getMode()))
  for _,offset in ipairs({{util.vector3(0,150,0),util.vector3(0,-150,0),util.vector3(-150,0,0),util.vector3(100,100,0),util.vector3(-100,100,0),util.vector3(100,-100,0),util.vector3(-100,-100,0)}}) do
   local candidate=target.position+offset
   local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,candidate,{{agentBounds=Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=30}})
   if #p>0 then
    local endpoint=p[#p];local distance=(endpoint-candidate):length()
    local eye=endpoint+util.vector3(0,0,eyeHeight)
    local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(eye,target:getBoundingBox().center,{{ignore=self}})
    print('AthleticsRoute candidate='..tostring(candidate)..' endpoint='..tostring(endpoint)..' error='..distance..' ray='..tostring(ray.hitObject))
    if distance<80 and ray.hitObject and ray.hitObject.id==target.id then
     local length=0;for i=2,#p do length=length+(p[i]-p[i-1]):length() end
     if not best or length<best.length then best={{length=length,goal=endpoint,path=p}} end
    end
   end
  end
  if not best then return end
  goal=best.goal;path=best.path;index=1;print('AthleticsRoute clear standing point='..tostring(goal));return
 end
 local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=80}})
 print('AthleticsRoute query status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#p)
 if #p>0 then local endp=p[#p];local d=endp-goal;print('AthleticsRoute endpoint='..tostring(endp)..' delta='..tostring(d));if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<90 then path=p;index=1;attempts=attempts+1;print('AthleticsRoute ready points='..#p);return end end
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not core.isWorldPaused() and (self.controls.movement~=0 or self.controls.sideMovement~=0) then if Actor.isSwimming(self) then swimTime=swimTime+dt elseif self.controls.run and not self.controls.sneak then runTime=runTime+dt end end
 age=age+dt;timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;local elapsed=timer;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Athletics route')
 print('Athletics sample run='..tostring(self.controls.run)..' swim='..tostring(Actor.isSwimming(self))..' rt='..runTime..' st='..swimTime..' forward='..self.controls.movement..' base='..require('openmw.types').NPC.stats.skills.athletics(self).base..' progress='..require('openmw.types').NPC.stats.skills.athletics(self).progress)
 if core.isWorldPaused() or age<3 then return end
 if not goal then route();return end
 local finish=goal-self.position
 if arrived or math.sqrt(finish.x*finish.x+finish.y*finish.y)<60 then
  arrived=true
  print('AthleticsRoute aim x=0 y=0')
  local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x66ac8))
  assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original Vilverin entrance missing')
  print('AthleticsRoute arrived missing=0 pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' target='..tostring(target))
  local aim=target:getBoundingBox().center
  local localAim=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
  local angle=math.atan2(localAim.x,-localAim.z)
  local elevation=-math.atan2(localAim.y,math.sqrt(localAim.x*localAim.x+localAim.z*localAim.z))
  local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}})
  print('AthleticsRoute actual range='..(aim-camera.getPosition()):length()..' ray='..tostring(ray.hitObject))
  if math.abs(angle)<.025 and math.abs(elevation)<.025 then print('AthleticsRoute facing destination') end
  print(string.format('AthleticsRoute look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(elevation*256+.5)))))
  return
 end
 if not path then route();return end
 local progress=(self.position-last):length();last=self.position
 if self.controls.movement>0 and progress<1 then stuck=stuck+elapsed else stuck=0 end
 if stuck>3 then print('AthleticsRoute replan');path=nil;stuck=0;assert(attempts<12,'Athletics route blocked repeatedly');return end
 while index<=#path do local v=path[index]-self.position;if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<45 then index=index+1 else break end end
 if index>#path then path=nil;return end
 local v=path[index]-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 print(string.format('AthleticsRoute aim x=%d y=%d point=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5))),index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,finish:length()))
 if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('AthleticsRoute facing') end
end}}}}
